title: Announcing our Investment in Collective
summary: Intuit Ventures announces its investment in Collective's Series B round, supporting an AI-powered finance platform that helps solopreneurs manage bookkeeping, payroll, taxes, and more.

- Announcing our Investment in Collective


Today, we are announcing Intuit Ventures’ investment in[Collective,](https://www.collective.com/) the AI-native finance department built for Businesses-of-One. We’re excited to participate in the **company’s Series B fundraise alongside General Catalyst, QED, SemperVirens, FT Partners, and Gradient among others** .


[More than 30 million Americans run a business with no employees other than themselves](https://www.census.gov/library/stories/2026/05/small-business-week.html) , generating roughly $1.7 trillion in receipts a year, and this is the fastest-growing segment of U.S. business formation. As a Business-of-One, these entrepreneurs wear all the hats when it comes to managing their business, from accounting to payroll to taxes. And when they do need help, costs are often prohibitive. The result is a costly, manual patchwork of DIY software and expensive, piecemeal professional help.


Collective replaces that patchwork with a single, done-for-you platform: entity formation, automated bookkeeping, payroll, tax filing, and a real-time AI assistant that handles the back office end-to-end. Members get outcomes, not just software. Collective has already helped its members reduce hours lost to finance administration and unlock savings most solopreneurs didn’t know were available to them, and the company continues to expand into adjacent needs like banking, insurance, and tax planning.


Collective’s mission of powering the modern Business-of-One aligns closely with Intuit’s mission to power prosperity for the consumers, businesses, and accountants we serve. As AI increases what a single operator can build and earn, the financial infrastructure supporting that operator has to keep pace. We were impressed by CEO Hooman Radfar’s vision for what a fully autonomous finance department can look like, and by how quickly the team has translated that vision into results for its members.


Congratulations to Hooman and the entire Collective team on this milestone!


*Intuit Ventures invests in world-class startups that are powering prosperity for consumers and businesses. To learn more about us, visit our[site](https://www.intuit.com/ventures/) and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/intuit-ventures/) .*
